info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Heulandite Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Heulandite Recliner Details Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed product information for the Heulandite recliner. This API allows businesses to define specifications, features, and other essential attributes of the recliner to enhance customer awareness and support marketing efforts. It caters to e-commerce platforms and product managers looking to enrich their catalogs and improve user experience. Through this API, organizations can streamline the onboarding of new products and ensure accurate data representation.

post.summary: Create details for a Heulandite recliner.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and submit detailed information for a Heulandite recliner. It accepts various attributes related to the recliner, which will be processed and stored accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary details to create or update the Heulandite Recliner information. The expected format is JSON, and it includes various attributes associated with the recliner.

200.description: Request completed successfully and detailed information is returned.
